lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gills. The central flank area displays vertical columns of three spots aligned with adjacent columns in a repeating pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal ridges. High-luminance circular blobs are positioned at these grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible across the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient where high-intensity pixels on the upper edge transition to low-intensity shadow pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a transition in pattern, with smaller, more densely clustered high-luminance spots towards the distal edge compared to the lateral flank.
